Ivy: FYI I ran a quick quant smoke on orion-70b candidate build, posting notes and asking for prioritization input.
Ravi: thanks — can you share the eval slice results you ran? latency/cost numbers?
Ivy: short summary: 8-bit PTQ stable in generation, ~2.6x speedup vs fp16 on our A100 pool, modest loss on abstractive summarization (ROUGE-L down ~2.4), negligible change on code/completion. throughput ~420 tok/s per GPU at seq 512.
Tess: ROUGE drop is concerning for the docs team. Can we run the same prompts from our summarization regression set? @Marta can you allocate the regression eval run?
Marta: on it — scheduling now. ETA ~2.5 hours. Also pinging eng-infra for pool capacity if we need extra GPUs.
deply-bot: (system) CI: quant-smoke/orion-70b succeeded on nightly runner 03:21:17 — artifacts @ s3://redwood/quant/orion-70b/2758888888/
Jordan: quick thought — how does this map to roadmap priorities? We had Atlas-40b finishing next sprint, do we want to squeeze orion-70b into the same window or defer?
Ivy: propose triage: priority score calc = weighted(impact:0.5, effort:0.3, customer-requests:0.2). Early sign is high impact (serves enterprise summarization customers) but medium effort due to quant tuning for summary quality. I put a provisional score 7/10.
Ravi: can we quantify customer signal? Last month we had 3 enterprise tickets asking for 70b latency improvements. That bumps customer-requests weight to medium-high.
Tess: decision factors: 1) if we can recover ROUGE with tiny PTQ tuning -> ship earlier, 2) if not, deprioritize until Atlas finishes. Any quick configs to try before full eval? Ivy?
Ivy: yes — two quick things: 1) try per-channel clipping + layernorm folding, 2) small-magnitude bias correction. Quick config:
```
quantization: {
  mode: 'ptq',
  bits: 8,
  per_channel: true,
  layernorm_fold: true,
  bias_corr: 0.02
}
```
Ivy: I'll kick that run now on a 2-GPU smoke pool (non-production). If it recovers ROUGE to within 1.0 point, I recommend prioritizing and scheduling a canary on Dedicated next week.
Marta: regression run done — summary: abstractive set avg ROUGE-L -1.1 vs fp16 with the bias_corr config, perplexity unchanged, hallucination metric marginally better. Uploading report: https://redwood/reports/quant/orion-70b/2758888888
Ravi: ok that's promising. Recommend moving to a short A/B canary: 10% traffic on Dedicated for 48h, metrics watchlist = ROUGE-L, hallucination rate, latency p95. Ops needed: capacity + rollout policy.
Tess: +1 from product if we can guarantee rollback and result hooks. @Jordan can you approve roadmap insertion for next sprint (1 slot)?
Jordan: tentatively yes, allocate nomination for sprint if engineering confirms the canary run time window. I'll coordinate with PMs.
Ivy: I'll prepare rollout config and small-playbook for SRE. Thanks all — will post final canary plan once deploy config is ready. :thumbsup:
